# State inventory

<!-- Generated by `task design:inventory` (frontend/tools/state-inventory.ts). Do not edit by hand: `bun test` fails when this file differs from what the generator prints. -->

There is no Figma file for this project: the prototype is the design source, and the owner approves each state in it. The Design source column names the scenario file that draws the state; the Reference column names what the state was built from: a screen of the owner's 2026-11-11 mockup (`mockup-2026-11-11#<screen>`, not committed), a v1 file under `internal/ui/web/src/` (`v1:<path>`), or `missing design`.

142 states. Each number opens its state at `http://localhost:8811/#s<N>` while the review build is served (`task design:build && task design:serve`). Numbers are permanent: a removed state is retired, never renumbered or reused. How states are reviewed and approved: [README.md](README.md).

## Not states

Deliberately not given a state.

| What | Why | Recorded in |
|---|---|---|
| No. 309 | There is no "last photo" state: photo navigation in Focus wraps around, as in v1. | frontend/prototype/scenarios/focus.tsx (header) |
| The folder picker | A macOS system panel: the app opens it, the system draws it. | docs/superpowers/plans/2026-11-11-design-prototype-and-gate.md, item 9 of "How this plan reads the prompt" |
| The About panel | A macOS system panel, as the folder picker. | docs/superpowers/plans/2026-11-11-design-prototype-and-gate.md, item 9 of "How this plan reads the prompt" |
| Scroll positions | Not states of their own. Where code sets a scroll position (the Focus rail, the Folder cluster list, Settings), the scroller carries a data-measured-by id, so the code that computes the position is part of the fingerprint. | frontend/src/design/measured.ts |
| Timers: toast auto-dismiss, delayed indicators | How long something stays on screen belongs to the app's containers, not to the design: each toast and indicator look is a state, its lifetime is not. Design code may not use setTimeout or setInterval (lint-design: timer). | docs/superpowers/plans/2026-11-11-design-prototype-and-gate.md (Global Constraints); frontend/tools/lint-design.ts |
| Motion in progress (a transition or animation mid-way) | Every scripted render freezes motion (html[data-freeze]); the motion rules themselves are part of every fingerprint (Tree.motionRules, Tree.atRules). | frontend/tools/extract.ts |
| A light theme, another OS look | docs/design/gate.json lists one theme (dark) and one OS (macos); the navigator's toggles exist with that one option each. | docs/design/gate.json |
| Nos. 870–899 | Reserved for the test-only fixture page of the check and parity self-tests (broken states 880–899, clean ones 870–879); never part of the prototype build. | frontend/tools/fixtures/kinds.ts |
